boundary_refinements.bukhari:2483:hi: The damaged opening participant is explicitly qualified, while the own later Wahb/Jabir exchange is separately attributed; no Urdu route is supplied to Hindi.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2505:hi: The full broken duration-answer attribution and literal reply stay together in context; the preceding complete Suraqah question and following Ali report remain separately selected.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2506:hi: This duplicate wording was independently read; its complete broken duration-answer clause remains source context under the same source-bound rationale.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2508:hi: The separately introduced pledge, one-day visit and own hearing are distinct source report families. The final reporting-voice household clause belongs with the hearing family.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2508:ur: The finite clauses remain exact, with no invented common date; the final third-person household statement is not converted into Prophet first-person speech.

bukhari:2469.hi: Read all939 characters of the source-labelled Hindi field, which is actually Latin-script text. Preserve its hi language label and original wording while recording observed script Latn. Anas transmits the oath/upper-room account, sprain, Umar's actual divorce question, negative answer and one-month oath,29-day stay and return. The parenthetical earlier5AH/Eela chronology is compiler history and the separate Eela-occasion label is explanatory event naming; keep those as source context. The closing parenthetical says the moon actually appeared on29 and supplies the cause for the following therefore-return; retain that finite causal event. Do not reconcile the chronology or fabricate a calendar/date.
bukhari:2469.ur: Read all775 Urdu characters independently. The Anas account and Umar dialogue supply real actions and answer, with month/29-day qualification. Preserve the finite moon-appearance clause inside the final parenthesis because the following اس لیے relies on that cause. The earlier5AH chronology and bracketed Eela occasion are explanatory source apparatus; preserve them visibly as context rather than merging their chronology into the narration. No external historical repair.

bukhari:2473.hi: Read all356 characters; source-labelled Hindi is visibly Latin script, requiring observed Latn with text/language label unchanged. Ikrimah explicitly hears Abu Hurayrah report the Prophet's decision: in a route dispute leave seven hands. Retain seven, conditional dispute setting and the parenthetic land object as a material indication of what the dispute concerns rather than dropping the physical-land qualification. Full actual chain/body supplied, no canonical/reference inference.
bukhari:2473.ur: Read all299 Urdu characters. Independently supports Ikrimah's hearing, Abu Hurayrah's report and the seven-hand route decision. The parenthetic کی زمین specifies the disputed object/space and may remain as supplied material scope. Do not convert hands into a modern distance or broaden this into a new legal rule; exact source statement only.

bukhari:2474.hi: Read all315 Latin-script characters in the Hindi-labelled field. The chain reaches Abdullah ibn Yazeed Ansari and supplies the Prophet's prohibition of plunder and mutilation. The inserted relative sentence jo Adi bin Sabit ke nana thay is transmitter genealogy, not part of the prohibition or a separately narrated event; retain that exact biographical clause as context while preserving the supplied chain and actual two prohibitions. Record observed Latn without translating or relabelling hi.
bukhari:2474.ur: Read all263 Urdu characters. The narrator route and both actual prohibitions are finite and source-attributed. The clause جو عدی بن ثابت کے نانا تھے is an inserted transmitter relationship explanation and should remain source context, rather than a narrated prohibition component. Original names, order and both objects of prohibition stay exact.

bukhari:2479.hi: Read all583 Latin-script characters in the hi-labelled field. Aisha's source account supplies hanging a pictured curtain, the Prophet seeing/removing/tearing it, her subsequent two cushions and his actual sitting on them. The parenthetic when-he-saw phrase is a finite causal trigger, and the Aisha-said parenthesis marks the source's shift from third-person introduction to her first-person continuation; both may stay as actual narrative framing, not compiler biography. Preserve exact quantities and sequence; observed script Latn, no relabelled language.
bukhari:2479.ur: Read all497 Urdu characters independently. The curtain scene, seeing trigger, Aisha's first-person cushion-making and the final habitual sitting are finite. The parentheses contain actual perception and speech-transition predicates, not technical definitions. Preserve them with the source-defined Aisha voice and the one scene family; no new visual/theological judgment added.

bukhari:2483.hi: Read all1219 Devanagari characters. The opening transmission is damaged and does not actually print the full Jabir/earlier chain given in Urdu; no chain completion is allowed. The own field nevertheless supplies expedition/300 soldiers/ration exhaustion, Abu Ubaydah's order, two bags and one-date ration. The remaining-provisions parenthesis materially scopes the collection command and stays. The parenthetic Rajab7AH date is compiler chronology; own-body mountain-comparison parenthesis is lexical size clarification and can be context. The printed I(Wahb) asks Jabir dialogue is an actual voice transition, then Jabir answers and resumes the fish/eighteen nights/ribs/camel passage. Preserve the printed voice marker with qualified source attribution and split that dialogue/resumed testimony from the damaged opening voice; same expedition family. Do not repair कहता to खाता or other source defects.
bukhari:2483.ur: Read all1223 Urdu characters. Independently supplies the full Abdullah/Yusuf/Malik/Wahb/Jabir route and Jabir expedition account, with300 men, shared remaining provisions, two bags, one-date ration, Wahb's explicit question/Jabir answer and resumed18-night fish/rib/camel account. Keep remaining-provisions condition and the I(Wahb) actual voice-transition marker; the standalone Rajab7AH parenthesis is chronology apparatus and the fish own-body gloss is lexical context. Distinct actual voices belong to one expedition family; no event/amount borrowed from Hindi or elsewhere.

bukhari:2485.hi: Read all435 Latin-script hi-labelled characters. Abul Najashi explicitly hears Rafi ibn Khadij report the group's Asr prayer with the Prophet, camel slaughter, division into ten shares and eating its cooked meat before sunset. All quantities/actions/time limit are actual report content and can stay whole. Record observed Latn while preserving the hi label and original letters.
bukhari:2485.ur: Read all361 Urdu characters independently. Rafi's own group-practice testimony includes Asr, slaughter, ten shares, cooking/eating before sunset. Whole field has finite actual content and no explanatory apparatus, identity uncertainty or source-only issue.

bukhari:2489.hi: Read all395 Latin-script characters in the hi-labelled field. Jabalah hears Ibn Umar report the prohibition of taking dates two at once without companions' permission. Retain the permission exception and the parenthetic shared-table setting as the source's domain of the act, not an unqualified rule about all private eating. No amount or source name change; observed Latn with hi label preserved.
bukhari:2489.ur: Read all334 Urdu characters. The actual Ibn Umar report has both companions' permission condition and two-dates-at-once action. The table parenthesis gives the shared eating setting and can remain as material scope. Whole finite own field, no external prohibition/fatwa claim.

bukhari:2494.hi: Read all2347 Latin-script characters completely. This is Urwah's sourced question to Aisha and her actual explanation/revelation-context account, not Prophet direct speech. Keep all Quran incipits/ranges actually quoted and their supplied translations, the orphan/property-sharing/dower/fairness conditions, the conditional permission predicate in parentheses, the follow-up question's these-girls-marriage scope, and final source Aisha explanation. Context only the explicit second-chain label, Surah-Nisa locator and the wali definition/examples of protective relatives. Distinguish initial Aisha answer, Urwah's relayed subsequent Aisha account and final explicit Aisha explanation within one conversation family. Source Hindi label retained with observed Latn; no external verse numbers or legal identities.
bukhari:2494.ur: Read all2004 Urdu characters independently. Preserve both literal chains, actual Quran quotations/translations, Aisha's orphan-care/shared-property/complete-mahr condition, actual counterfactual permission consequence, and the specific marriage-question domain before the later quoted revelation. The second-chain marker, surah-location parenthesis and guardian lexical examples are apparatus. The final explicit Aisha interpretation is an eligible Companion saying within the same source discussion; it must not be deleted as anonymous compiler commentary or labelled Prophet speech. No number matching or source-word repair.

bukhari:2495.hi: Read all470 Latin-script characters. Source route explicitly prints Zubairi and must not be repaired to a familiar name. Jabir reports shufa for undivided property and its cessation when boundaries/routes are divided or changed. The parenthetic zameen jaidad waghera is a lexical/examples gloss of amwal; it may stay as context while every actual undivided/boundary/route condition remains selected and already identifies the spatial setting. Do not formulate a modern legal rule. Record observed Latn only.
bukhari:2495.ur: Read all397 Urdu characters. Independently supports Jabir report of the undivided-property shufa statement and both boundary and route conditions. Keep the printed زبیری name. The زمین جائیداد وغیرہ parenthesis explains the property noun with examples, rather than adding an actual transmitted predicate; retain in complete context, with all operative spatial conditions intact. No inferred grades/identity or extra legal scope.

bukhari:2496.hi: Read all450 Latin-script characters separately from2495. Own chain prints Zuhri, and Jabir reports shufa for still-undivided shared property with boundary/route separation ending that right. Entire source has finite attributed content, no lexical parentheses or apparatus. Preserve this occurrence and chain spelling independently, with observed Latn and no canonical/legal repair.
bukhari:2496.ur: Read all383 Urdu characters. Keep the complete source Zuhri chain, the partners' still-undivided property scope and both boundary/route conditions. This separate source occurrence is not merged with2495 despite related content; all own words may remain.

bukhari:2497.hi: Read all584 Latin-script hi characters. Sulaiman asks Abu Minhal about immediate trade; Abu Minhal reports his own/companion purchase and encounter with Bara, then Bara reports a distinct earlier transaction with Zaid and their actual question to the Prophet with take-immediate/leave-credit reply. Separate Abu Minhal's later transaction/encounter from Bara's earlier prophetic encounter into two families; do not collapse all first-person acts onto Sulaiman. The two naqd parentheses are lexical glosses of the already supplied hathon-hath wording and may be context. Preserve all actual cash/credit alternatives and both participant groups. No unspecified trade material inferred.
bukhari:2497.ur: Read all505 Urdu characters independently. Same own source sequence defines Sulaiman's inquiry, Abu Minhal/current companion and Bara/Zaid prior event, requiring qualified actual voices and two event families. Both نقد parentheses gloss ہاتھوں ہاتھ; keep those as context with the full immediate-versus-credit commands intact. No borrowed goods, narrator metadata or modern transaction ruling.

bukhari:2498.hi: Read all584 characters of this second supplied source occurrence in full, although its wording equals2497. Retain the independent2498 identity and its own source hash. Sulaiman/Abu Minhal encounter then Bara/Zaid prophetic inquiry are two actual event families with first-person voice shifts as printed. Only the two naqd lexical glosses are context; every finite purchase/question/reply remains. Observed Latn, original hi label unchanged.
bukhari:2498.ur: Read all505 Urdu characters for2498, not inferred from the matching2497 field. The repeated source wording still belongs to its own separate provider ID. Preserve both transaction families, exact named voices and the immediate/credit distinction. The two parenthetic نقد synonyms are context; no extra goods or external identity supplied.

bukhari:2499.hi: Read all334 Latin-script characters. Nafi transmits from the source-named Abdullah only; do not expand that printed name from a familiar route. The Prophet's Khaybar-land arrangement expressly requires the recipients to work/sow/plough and gives them half the yield. Retain all actual conditions and the half share, without modern legal inference; whole own report and observed Latn are supported.
bukhari:2499.ur: Read all279 Urdu characters independently. Keep the source Abdullah name unexpanded, Khaybar location, recipients, cultivation condition and half-yield term exactly. No bracketed apparatus or incomplete body; this is a finite attributed arrangement report.

bukhari:2505.hi: Read all1249 Devanagari characters completely. Own source names Ibn Abbas, gives fourth-DhulHijjah morning arrival, the change/release command, actual Jabir surprised question/gesture, ensuing sermon and conditional hady statement, Suraqah's scope question and Ali's arrival/continuing ihram/shared hady. Hindi omits wording within the conditional speech and prints the defective answer नहीं के लिए है, which does not supply a meaningful duration. Preserve all source bytes and visibly qualify defects; do not complete them from Urdu. The incoherent duration-reply fragment should remain bounded context while retaining the actual preceding question and following Ali report separately. No new lasting-rule inference from the damaged Hindi answer.
bukhari:2505.ur: Read all1227 Urdu characters fully. This own field actually contains the fuller conditional hady statement and Suraqah's complete not-only-you-but-forever answer, unlike Hindi. Preserve all its printed questions, answers, timing, companions and Ali continuation; no statement that the Hindi supplies the same answer. The قربانی parenthesis only glosses the already printed ہدی term and can be context. Actual ritual permissions, conditional limits and intimate-content wording remain literal source report, not newly translated or legislated.

bukhari:2506.hi: Read all1249 Hindi characters for the distinct2506 source ID, not inferred from the exact matching2505 wording. This own text repeats the Ibn Abbas/Jabir/sermon/Suraqah/Ali sequence and the same missing conditional words and incoherent नहीं के लिए है reply. Keep provider IDs and evidence distinct, qualify the damage and retain the bounded reply fragment as context without borrowing Urdu's duration answer. Other actual finite source reports/questions remain eligible; no new script correction is needed for this Devanagari field.
bukhari:2506.ur: Read all1227 Urdu characters for2506 separately. Actual full conditional speech and permanent-duration reply are supplied here, with Ali's same vow and shared hady. Preserve this occurrence's own words and named-source voices, including the intimate Jabir objection and gesture. Only the lexical قربانی gloss is context; no correction/identity merger with2505 and no filling its Hindi sibling.

bukhari:2508.hi: Read all574 Latin-script hi characters. Anas transmits the armour-for-barley statement, his own one-day arrival with barley bread/stale fat, and his actual hearing of the Prophet's household-provision claim. Preserve the no-morning-or-evening/at-most-one-sa limitation. The closing although-he-had-nine-houses third-person observation is actual finite report content, but should be a separately qualified reporting-voice component, not silently assigned as Prophet first-person speech. Keep the ordered source clauses without asserting the pledge, visit and hearing happened on one date. Original word choice and observed Latn remain.
bukhari:2508.ur: Read all476 Urdu characters independently. The actual Anas report includes collateral, his food visit and the heard source statement, followed by the literal nine-house qualification. Preserve all quantities and negative temporal scope. Distinguish the final third-person reporting observation from the quotation rather than treating it as a lexical gloss or inventing that the Prophet said it himself. No missing commodity, debt amount or event date is supplied.

bukhari:2513.hi: Read all281 Devanagari characters. The complete Aisha report states the Prophet bought grain from the source-described Jewish counterparty on a term and pledged his armour. Keep the term arrangement and collateral object exactly, without adding a grain quantity, duration, counterparty name or external legal label. Whole own field is finite.
bukhari:2513.ur: Read all258 Urdu characters. Independently retain the exact chain, Aisha attribution, term purchase and armour pledge; no parentheses or compiler appendix. All supplied body may be selected without completing any unstated amount or period.

bukhari:2519.hi: Read all417 Devanagari characters. Source chain reaches Asma bint Abi Bakr and supplies the actual instruction to free slaves during a solar eclipse. Retain that own report and the chain's literal Fatima bin Munzir spelling without correction. The final Musa/Ali ibn Madini/Abdul Aziz Darawardi/Hisham parallel-route statements contain no additional report body and should remain transmission context, not a second narrated event.
bukhari:2519.ur: Read all367 Urdu characters. Independently supports Asma's eclipse-related instruction. The final statement that Ali ibn Madini also transmitted this through Darawardi/Hisham is route-only apparatus and remains context; no body or actor is imported into it. Preserve the source chain spelling and the first full actual report.

bukhari:2520.hi: Read all293 Devanagari characters. Asma bint Abi Bakr supplies an actual passive report: we were ordered to free slaves at a solar eclipse. This own field does not name the issuer, so retain it as Asma's reported received instruction with that limit; do not promote it to explicit Prophet speech using adjacent2519 or familiar canonical wording. Whole source has finite content and the feminine bint chain spelling remains literal.
bukhari:2520.ur: Read all257 Urdu characters independently. Asma reports the group was instructed at a solar eclipse; the issuer is not explicitly identified in this own field. The actual Companion report can remain whole with a qualified unspecified-issuer classification, preserving the passive voice rather than importing the preceding occurrence's attribution.

bukhari:2532.hi: Read all424 Devanagari characters. Qais transmits a finite Abu Hurayrah journey/slave-separation report; do not assert Qais personally witnessed it. The middle फिर यही हदीस बयान की / इस में यूँ है text is an explicit omitted-report pointer and stays context. The final own Abu Hurayrah declaration asking the addressed figure bearing the prophetic honorific to witness that he is for Allah is actually supplied and eligible as a separate qualified Companion-declaration fragment in the same interrupted source family. Do not insert missing reunion details, the word freed, or a fully named addressee where the own text uses only pronoun/honorific.
bukhari:2532.ur: Read all391 Urdu characters. Preserve Qais's transmitted historical opening, Islam-intention and the slave's accidental separation; the pointer پھر یہی حدیث بیان کی / اس میں یوں ہے supplies no missing body and is context. The actual later Abu Hurayrah witness/declaration is separately selected with the source honorific-qualified addressee and exact وہ اللہ کے لیے ہے words. Do not complete the omitted sequence or equate the abbreviated wording with an externally supplied full manumission report.
